definitions.explanation: Ships and boats as a class, especially large ones. The formal word used in law, insurance, news reports and the shipping business.

examples.japanese: ⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{船舶|せんぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{停泊|ていはく}→停泊：20272_teihaku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Ships are anchored in the harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、{船舶|せんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運航|うんこう}→運航：09229_unkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, ship services were suspended.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{海峡|かいきょう}→海峡：31684_kaikyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{船舶|せんぱく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: This strait is one of the places in the world through which the most ships pass.

notes:
The formal, collective counterpart of ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧. In conversation people say ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧; {船舶|せんぱく} belongs to official and technical writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {船舶|せんぱく}{会社|がいしゃ}: shipping company
- {船舶|せんぱく}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: boat operator's license
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{船舶|せんぱく}: large vessels
- {船舶|せんぱく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{航行|こうこう}→航行：31628_koukou⟧: navigation of ships

COUNTING PATTERNS:
Large ships are counted with {隻|せき}; small boats with {艘|そう}.
